FolderCompare.Title: Folder Compare
FolderCompare.Subtitle: Compare file differences between two folders
FolderCompare.Tip_Content:
After selecting source and target folders, click the 'Start Compare' button. Results will be shown in the list on the left.

With Hash Compare, files are compared by MD5 content. With Music Title Compare, files are compared by their audio tag title (useful for music libraries).

VideoTranscode.Interp_Hint: Generates intermediate frames while preserving duration and audio sync. Combined processing order can be automatic or selected manually. Select Force SDR for HDR sources. NPU compilation can take longer for large frames; GPU is recommended for speed.
VideoTranscode.Interp_GifHint: The GIF options determine the target frame rate.
VideoTranscode.Interp_SizeLimit: AI interpolation supports up to 3840×2160 pixels; the input exceeds this limit.
VideoTranscode.Interp_InvalidModel: The interpolation model has incompatible inputs or outputs. Verify the model again.
VideoTranscode.Interp_InvalidFrames: Interpolation frames have mismatched dimensions or pixel formats.
VideoTranscode.Interp_InvalidRate: The interpolation target must be between 1 and 240 fps; supported multipliers are 2× and 4×.
VideoTranscode.Interp_HdrUnsupported: Interpolation currently requires SDR input. Select Force SDR under HDR output and try again.
VideoTranscode.Hdr_Hint: HDR uses 10-bit PQ / BT.2020 output and expands SDR highlights. SDR tone-maps HDR luminance.
VideoTranscode.Msg_HdrCodecUnsupported: This encoder or profile does not support 10-bit HDR. Choose 10-bit HEVC or AV1 encoding.
VideoTranscode.Title: Video Transcode
VideoTranscode.Subtitle: Trim a clip, preview its frames, and batch convert to video or GIF
VideoTranscode.Sr_AllowCpu: Allow CPU fallback when hardware fails
VideoTranscode.Sr_Hint: Models are shared with image upscaling. SPAN prioritizes speed; LiveAction SPAN is native 2× for live-action footage (noncommercial license). Windows ML manages GPU / NPU; install compatible acceleration on demand.
VideoTranscode.Msg_SrHardwareFailed: The selected hardware cannot run this model. Choose another accelerator or allow CPU fallback.
VideoTranscode.Msg_SrSizeLimit: Upscaling exceeds the memory limit: 8192 pixels per dimension and about 33.5 million total pixels. Reduce the scale or crop the source first.
VideoTranscode.Hint_Trim: Each file has its own range. Drag either end to preview; conversion follows the current source frame.
VideoTranscode.Preview_Empty: Add and select a video to preview and trim
VideoTranscode.Preview_Failed: Cannot preview this position. Try another position.
VideoTranscode.Msg_InvalidTrim: Invalid trim range: the end must follow the start, and the start must be within the source duration.
VideoTranscode.Hint_OutputDirEmpty: Leave empty to write next to each source with '_output' suffix; when set, folder-added files mirror their original structure (singly-added files go to the folder root)
VideoTranscode.Hint_Crf: Lower CRF = higher quality (18-23 recommended, 0 lossless)
VideoTranscode.Hint_Hardware: Explicit selection: NVIDIA = NVENC, Intel = QSV (Windows) / VAAPI (Linux), AMD = AMF (Windows) / VAAPI (Linux). Requires GPU support in FFmpeg build.
VideoTranscode.Hint_HardwareVaapi: VAAPI will use /dev/dri/renderD128 on Linux; ensure user has video group permission.
VideoTranscode.Hint_AudioGain: 0 = passthrough, -30..30 dB step 0.5 dB; positive = boost, negative = reduce
VideoTranscode.Msg_Stopped: Stopped: {0}/{1} done, {2} failed — see log for details
VideoTranscode.Msg_FfmpegLoadFailed: Failed to load bundled FFmpeg libraries: {0}
VideoTranscode.Msg_NoVideoStream: No video stream in the file.
VideoTranscode.CheckBox_IncludeAllInFolder: Include all files when scanning folder
VideoTranscode.Msg_FileProbeFailed: Cannot recognize this file as a video: {0}
VideoTranscode.Sr_InstallHardware: Install / update GPU and NPU acceleration
VideoTranscode.Sr_InstallCanceled: Installation canceled or timed out; retry later

AudioTranscode.Title: Audio Transcode
AudioTranscode.Subtitle: Batch audio conversion (built-in in-process FFmpeg, tags/covers carried over)
AudioTranscode.Hint_Format: Lossless: FLAC / ALAC / WAV / AIFF (bit depth selectable); lossy: MP3 / AAC / OGG / Opus / WMA / AC3 / MP2
AudioTranscode.Hint_BitDepth: Auto follows source: 24-bit stays 24-bit, 16-bit/unknown yields 16-bit, 32-bit/float/DSD yields 32-bit/float
AudioTranscode.Hint_SampleRate: Same-as-source snaps to the encoder's supported rates (MP3 caps at 48 kHz, Opus only 8/12/16/24/48 kHz); DSD sources default to 176.4 kHz
AudioTranscode.Hint_CopyMetadata: Reads title/artist/album/track/year and the cover from the source and writes them to the output; ogg/opus covers use METADATA_BLOCK_PICTURE
AudioTranscode.Msg_FileProbeFailed: Cannot recognize this file as audio: {0}
AudioTranscode.Msg_NoAudioStream: No audio stream in the file.

Lyrics.Title: Lyrics & subtitles
Lyrics.Subtitle: Batch transcription for audio and songs, with multilingual word timing and offline processing.
Lyrics.Hint_OutputEmpty: Leave empty to write lyric/subtitle sidecars next to each source using its original stem; when set, folder-added files mirror their original structure
Lyrics.Hint_Saving: 15-second chunks reduce memory per run. GPU is preferred with automatic CPU fallback.
Lyrics.Hint_Auto: INT4 with GPU acceleration by default; CPU fallback if unavailable. Without a metadata script hint, one ASR session probes Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, Spanish, Russian, German and Portuguese using at most two 8-second windows. Recognition and alignment load sequentially. First use downloads about 5 GB.
Lyrics.Hint_Precision: FP32 weights of the same model. About 10 GB of additional downloads and higher RAM usage.
Lyrics.Hint_Formats: All formats export readable UTF-8 text. KRC keeps word tags without compression or encryption; QRC uses plaintext XML. Word formats require alignment.
Lyrics.Hint_AddFiles: Add files to start. Failed or cancelled tasks can be retried.
Lyrics.Hint_Drop:
Add audio files or drop a folder here
Batch processing, recursive scanning and queue recovery
Lyrics.Hint_Editor:
Select a completed task to preview lyrics.
Edit [mm:ss.xx]text, then export or realign.
Lyrics.Models_Ready: Models verified. Offline processing is ready.
Lyrics.Export_NeedsAlignment: Word timings are missing. Select a language and realign before exporting word formats.
Lyrics.Error_EmptyAudio: Audio is empty or too short.
Lyrics.Error_NoVocals: No usable lyrics detected. The audio may be instrumental or silent.
Lyrics.Error_SelectAlignmentLanguage: Select the lyrics language before alignment.
Lyrics.Error_LineDuration: Invalid line interval or over 60 seconds. Split and correct the line.
Lyrics.Error_Options: Invalid language, chunk duration or line length.
Lyrics.Error_Formats: Select at least one output format.
Lyrics.Error_QueueRecovery: Queue recovery failed. Add files again.
Lyrics.Error_QueueSave: Could not save the queue. Check folder permissions.
Lyrics.Warning_LineTimingOnly: Word alignment is unavailable for this language; results use chunk timing.
Lyrics.Warning_Alignment: Some words have zero alignment duration. Listen and correct the timing.
Lyrics.Warning_Review: Music, accompaniment and overlapping vocals can affect recognition and timing. Review the result.
Lyrics.Error_TokenLimit: Decoding repeated indefinitely. Shorten chunks or select a language, then retry.
Lyrics.Warning_SplitRetry: Difficult segments were retried with shorter chunks. Review those segments.
Lyrics.Warning_GpuFallback: GPU loading or inference failed. The affected step completed on CPU.
